question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Now compute the average total quantity across all root packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        r.id AS root_id,
        r.id AS current_id,
        1 AS depth,
        CAST(r.id AS VARCHAR) AS path,
        1.0::DOUBLE AS cumulative_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT id FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id AS id FROM packaging_relations
            UNION
            SELECT DISTINCT contains_id AS id FROM packaging_relations
        ) all_ids
        WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    ) r
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.path || ',' || CAST(pr.contains_id AS VARCHAR),
        pt.cumulative_qty * CAST(pr.qty AS DOUBLE)
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.current_id AS leaf_id,
        pt.cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_quantity
    FROM leaf_items
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_quantity) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM root_totals
